name: home-assistant-pp-mcp
description: Safe household actions, offline memory, and evidence-backed answers on top of the full Home Assistant control surface.

hass_config_dir.title: HASS_CONFIG_DIR
hass_config_dir.description: Sets HASS_CONFIG_DIR for the Home Assistant MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

hass_supervisor_url.title: HASS_SUPERVISOR_URL
hass_supervisor_url.description: Sets HASS_SUPERVISOR_URL for the Home Assistant MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

hass_token.title: HASS_TOKEN
hass_token.description: Optional. Sets HASS_TOKEN for the Home Assistant MCP server.

home_assistant_bearer_auth.title: HOME_ASSISTANT_BEARER_AUTH
home_assistant_bearer_auth.description: Optional. Sets HOME_ASSISTANT_BEARER_AUTH for the Home Assistant MCP server.

home_assistant_server.title: HOME_ASSISTANT_SERVER
home_assistant_server.description: Sets HOME_ASSISTANT_SERVER for the endpoint template variable {server}.

supervisor_token.title: SUPERVISOR_TOKEN
supervisor_token.description: Sets SUPERVISOR_TOKEN for the Home Assistant MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
